messages.subject: Deploy ShinyApp
parts:
I am trying to follow the instructions on configuring ShinyApps: https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/blob/master/guide/guide.md, however I am getting the error message when I enter the command [shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name="aakash", token="***", secret="***")] in R Session. 
The error message is: Error in loadNamespace(name) : there is no package called ‘shinyapps’ 

Additional Information:
R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
Shiny: 0.8.0.99

Please note that I have successfully configured Shiny-Server in Centos6.4. However, I am really excited to deploy my first app over the web(public) and see if it really works.
It would be really great if you could suggest if I am doing any mistakes and help rectify.

Thank you,

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Deploy ShinyApp
parts:
Did you install the shinyapps package using devtools?

You should run:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')
